subject: Re: FluxForge integration - sandbox crediting, attribution & rev-share mechanics
messages:

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FluxForge x Redwood - possible integrated marketplace + sandbox credit ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the integration looks solid. FluxForge is evaluating 3 partners to include as marketplace integrations and we'd like to propose a short commercial pilot to validate GTM motion. High level asks: 1) a $25k sandbox credit allocation (usable over 90 days) for product and joint demos, 2) an attribution & lead-registration process so FluxForge gets first-touch credit for inbound leads we intro, and 3) a simple rev-share framework for referrals that convert to paid accounts.

We attached a one-page MOU that outlines our ask and a preliminary commission table (just starting point). Would Redwood be open to a pilot with an escrowed demo credit pool and a 12-month lookback on lead crediting?

If helpful, we can put together a short mutual action plan with milestones (tech enablement, co-marketing, pilot cadence). Looking forward to a quick read.

Best,
Sara Kim
Head of Partnerships | FluxForge
[sent from mobile]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FluxForge x Redwood - possible integrated marketplace + sandbox credit ask

Sara — really appreciate the clear ask and the MOU. Short answers up front: yes to a timeboxed sandbox credit pool, yes to a lead-registration flow (we'll want HubSpot registration + hashed email proofing), and yes to testing a simple rev-share on first-year ARR for converted referrals.

Practical follow-ups:
- Can you confirm the expected demo cadence (# of joint demos / month) so Ben can size the credit bucket against token usage?
- We generally use a 6-12 month lookback for attribution; for pilots we can accommodate 12 months but we need the registration/timestamp step to be explicit.
- Proposed rev-share: surface-level OK but we prefer milestone-triggered payouts (50% on conversion, 50% after 90 days of paid usage to protect against churn).

Marissa (cc) — can you draft the pilot terms and an onboarding checklist? Ben — pinging you to build a quick token/credit burn estimate and an operational escrow mechanism (we've done a temporary promo credit ledger before; want one for joint-demo pool).

I'll put together a mutual action plan draft and share by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: FluxForge x Redwood - possible integrated marketplace + sandbox credit ask

Thanks Karthik & Sara — I took a first pass at terms and attached a short pilot T&C fragment. Key points I'm proposing for the pilot (summarized):

- Pilot length: 90 days (credit pool must be used within the window).
- Credit pool: $30,000 USD Redwood promo credits allocated to "FluxForge Pilot" ledger. Credits consumed by token usage and egress apply against that pool.
- Attribution: FluxForge must register leads in HubSpot using the joint-referral form; Redwood will capture a hashed identifier and timestamp. Lead window: 12 months post-registration for attribution to FluxForge.
- Conversion payout waterfall: 50% of first invoice upon paid conversion, 50% after 90 days of continuous paid usage (to mitigate early churn). Payouts are calculated on net ARR recognized by Redwood (gross-to-net adjustments apply).
- Clawback: If a customer cancels within the 90-day post-conversion window, Redwood may reclaim the second tranche from FluxForge (clawback proportional to refunded amounts).
- Escrow/operational flow: Ben, can you confirm whether we should use a ledger hold in billing (preferred) or a third-party escrow?

Attachments: pilot-tc-draft.docx (docx)

Ben — notes for ops below: please build a quick model (sensitivity to demo frequency, avg token consumption per demo, and expected conversion rate) and advise on whether $30k is conservative or aggressive. Also confirm docs needed for the HubSpot registration webhook and proofing.

—Marissa
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Sara Kim <sara@fluxforge.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FluxForge x Redwood - sandbox crediting & payout mechanics (ops)

Sara / team — quick ops update after modeling the ask. Summary: $30k sandbox credit pool looks appropriate for up to ~40 joint demos assuming mixed short/long sessions and some embedding/ft usage. Two operational asks before we finalize:

1) Lead registration: FluxForge must submit via the joint-referral form (HubSpot), and include the customer email + company domain. We'll run a nightly sync that writes the hashed id to the deal record. Please confirm you can require the email field during registration.

2) Payout schedule & docs: We'll implement the 50/50 waterfall. Payouts will be issued via ACH/net-30 after the payout milestone (we can also do vendor credit against future AWS/redwood bills if you prefer). For transparency we'll share a monthly partner ledger.

3) Escrow mechanism: Ops recommends an internal ledger hold (preferred) rather than third-party escrow to simplify tax and accounting. For the pilot we'll move $30k into a 'promo credit' ledger and allocate consumption against it. If you prefer a third-party escrow, we can discuss but it will add ~2 weeks to setup.

Next steps: Sara — if acceptable, please sign the MOU and I'll create a pilot ledger and the HubSpot referral form (will share links). Karthik & Marissa — I'll draft the ledger entries and provide sample payout journal entries for legal/accounting review.

Best,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
